measurement_notes: All initial and follow-up samples are retained. Runtime comparisons pool every available matched pair per workload/reference/mode; no observations are removed. The focused recheck measures only unresolved modes and references.
Compiler acceptance uses the independently C-bootstrapped bundle, not the intermediate host compiler. Compiler and library identities were checked before and after each run.
Host contention affects absolute timings. Approximate paired bootstrap intervals do not establish a universal performance guarantee.
The 250k fresh root lines/s and universal C/Rust runtime targets remain unmet. Absolute rates across changing host loads are not a compiler speedup.
